# Model for a municipal reservoir, with standard water quality characteristics
# Author: Peter Norvig (simplifications by Stephen Wolfram)
# From the Wolfram Demonstrations Project, http://demonstrations.wolfram.com/

# We represent the water by a couple of differential equations:

class Reservoir:
    def __init__(self, T0=60, R0=2, S0=1, D0=2, m=1):
        self.T = [T0, R0, S0, D0]
        self.m = float(m)
    def delta(self, T, R, S, D):
        dTdT = 0.12 * (T - R)
        dRdT = -0.12 * (T - R) + D
        dSdT = (0.2 * (T - R) + D)
